value_stream.name: Customer Data Platform, Single Customer View & Identity Resolution

fields.Participants: CDP Team, Marketing (links to VS-14), Loyalty (links to VS-13), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Trade/Key Account (links to VS-11/VS-107), Insights (links to VS-28.1/VS-44), Data Science (links to VS-30.2), Privacy (links to VS-91)
fields.Trigger: Segment need (links to W3887); campaign brief (links to VS-14)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "CDP/Marketing build and maintain segments on the profile" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document segment lineage for governance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "counts/quality for activation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-608 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Segmentation, Activation & Personalization Foundation (PA-126.2).)
- operational: daily/real-time refresh; operational: build-time enforcement (links to W3885)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-segment risk**: Segments not refreshed deliver wrong targets; mitigated by daily/real-time refresh
- **Consent-bypass risk**: Segments built without consent filtering; mitigated by build-time enforcement (links to W3885)
System Touchpoints: - CDP segments; golden profile (links to W3884); consent (links to W3885); merchandising (links to VS-01); loyalty (links to VS-13); trade (links to VS-11/VS-107); insights (links to VS-28.1/VS-44); data governance (links to VS-28.2)
Time Estimate: - Continuous + ~1–3 days per major segment build

steps.activity: CDP/Marketing build and maintain segments on the profile (links to W3884/W3887): RFM, lifecycle stage, value tier, trade-pro vs DIY, category-affinity (links to VS-01), channel-preference, win-back/lapse-risk, new-mover/home-builder, seasonal (links to VS-13.2), and ad-hoc campaign segments

CDP/Privacy enforce consent and suppression at segment build (links to W3885), apply frequency caps and global suppression (do-not-contact, deceased, invalid), and document segment lineage for governance (links to VS-28.2)
CDP/Marketing publish segment counts/quality for activation (links to W3891), monitor segment drift, and refresh/refine with insights (links to VS-28.1/VS-44)

fields.Participants: CDP Team, IT (links to VS-27/VS-113), Marketing (links to VS-14), Loyalty (links to VS-13), Sales Enablement/Clienteling (links to VS-124), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), POS (links to VS-08), Contact Center (links to VS-13), Data Science (links to VS-30.2)

- System auto-log of "CDP/Data Science/Marketing define NBA logic" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-608 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Segmentation, Activation & Personalization Foundation (PA-126.2).)
- operational: caching and sub-second API; operational: tasteful rules and consent (links to W3885)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Latency risk**: Slow profile/NBA API degrades POS/checkout (links to POS-013 SLA); mitigated by caching and sub-second API
- **Creepy-personalization risk**: Over-personalization alienates customers/privacy concern; mitigated by tasteful rules and consent (links to W3885)

steps.activity: CDP/IT expose the real-time customer profile and next-best-action (NBA) API to touchpoints: POS customer lookup + clienteling prompt (links to VS-08/VS-124), ecommerce logged-in experience (links to VS-10), app home (links to VS-75), contact-center screen-pop (links to VS-13) — within sub-second latency

CDP/Data Science/Marketing define NBA logic: best next product/category to attach, best offer (links to VS-58/VS-13 loyalty), best message, service opportunity (estimation links to VS-09.2, installation links to VS-12), and trade-pro value prop (links to VS-43) — governed and explainable
CDP/Marketing capture NBA acceptance/outcomes, feed model learning (links to W3892/W3895), and tune offers by segment/channel

fields.Participants: CDP Team, Marketing (links to VS-14), Loyalty (links to VS-13), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Mobile App (links to VS-75), Store Ops/Comms (links to VS-07/VS-63), Paid Media/Agency (links to VS-14.2), Privacy (links to VS-91), IT (links to VS-27/VS-113)

steps.activity: CDP/Marketing syndicate consented audiences to activation channels: email/SMS/push (links to VS-14/VS-75), ecommerce on-site personalization (links to VS-10), in-store/clienteling (links to VS-124/VS-63), and paid-media/publisher audiences (Meta/Google — links to VS-14.2) via consented audience export/hash-matching
CDP/Privacy enforce consent per channel (links to W3885), suppress non-consented/invalid, and maintain the activation audit trail (who/what/channel/when) for NPC compliance (links to VS-91)
CDP/Marketing track activation delivery and reach, reconcile to segment counts, and capture downstream response for measurement (links to W3896)

CDP/Ecommerce serve personalized ecommerce/app experiences (home, search ranking, PDP, cart attach, recommendations — links to VS-10/VS-75) and capture interactions for learning

CDP/Data Science run model governance (links to W3862 pattern): A/B champion/challenger (links to W3895), bias/fairness, performance monitoring, refresh, and explainability for merchandising partners (links to VS-01)

- System auto-measure of "measure journey performance" (replaces manual Step 3).

workflows.name: Customer Lifetime Value, Churn & Propensity Modeling

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "build and refresh CLV" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate model accuracy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-608 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Segmentation, Activation & Personalization Foundation (PA-126.2).)
- operational: service-floor policy; operational: refresh cadence and validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **CLV-misuse risk**: CLV used to discriminate in service (links to VS-91/VS-85); mitigated by service-floor policy
- **Model-accuracy risk**: Stale CLV misallocates retention spend; mitigated by refresh cadence and validation
System Touchpoints: - Model platform (links to VS-30.2); profile (links to W3884); loyalty (links to VS-13); trade (links to VS-11/VS-107); merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101); finance (links to VS-17.4); analytics (links to VS-28.1)
Time Estimate: - ~2–4 weeks per model cycle + continuous operationalization

steps.activity: CDP/Data Science build and refresh CLV (historical + predictive), churn/lapse-risk, and propensity models (next-category, trade-pro conversion links to VS-43, service-attach links to VS-09, financing propensity links to VS-38), with the score written to the profile (links to W3884)

CDP/Marketing/Loyalty/Trade operationalize scores into action: high-CLV nurture, churn-prevention win-back (links to W3893), trade-pro upsell to high-propensity (links to VS-107), and merchandising/category planning input (links to VS-01/VS-101)

CDP/Finance/Insights use CLV for customer-economics decisions (acquisition-cost ceiling links to VS-121, retention-investment, channel-value links to VS-14) and validate model accuracy (links to W3895)

fields.Participants: CDP Team, Insights (links to VS-28.1), Marketing (links to VS-14), Loyalty (links to VS-13), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Trade (links to VS-11), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Data Science (links to VS-30.2)

Automation Opportunity: - workflow automation; system-driven processing with exception handling
Controls: - CTL-608 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Segmentation, Activation & Personalization Foundation (PA-126.2).)
- operational: MTA/MMM; operational: right-sized test design
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution-gaming risk**: Last-click attribution over-credits lower-funnel channels; mitigated by MTA/MMM
- **Holdout-cost risk**: Holdouts forgo revenue; mitigated by right-sized test design
System Touchpoints: - Analytics/BI (links to VS-28.1); marketing channels (links to VS-14); loyalty (links to VS-13); ecommerce (links to VS-10); finance/sales (links to VS-17.4); model platform (links to VS-30.2); revenue assurance (links to VS-118)
Time Estimate: - ~1–2 weeks per attribution cycle + per-test setup

steps.activity: CDP/Insights run multi-touch attribution (MTA) and/or marketing-mix modeling (MMM) across channels (paid media links to VS-14.2, loyalty links to VS-13, email/SMS/push, ecommerce links to VS-10, in-store links to VS-07), reconciling to sales (links to VS-17.4)
CDP/Marketing run A/B and holdout experimentation on offers, creative, journeys (links to W3893), and personalization (links to W3892), with statistically valid design and holdout groups

CDP/Insights publish attribution/experiment results, recommend budget reallocation across channels/tactics (links to VS-14/VS-33), and feed learnings to models (links to W3894) and revenue assurance (links to VS-118)

fields.Participants: CDP Team, Insights (links to VS-28.1), Marketing (links to VS-14), Loyalty (links to VS-13), Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101), Trade (links to VS-11/VS-107), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Coupons/Promo (links to VS-58)
fields.Trigger: Campaign close (links to VS-14); promotion end (links to VS-58)
fields.Volume: ~6 major campaigns/yr + monthly hot deals + loyalty/promo

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "CDP/Insights measure campaign/offer incrementality" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "flag unprofitable offers" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report CDP-attributed value to the steering committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-608 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Segmentation, Activation & Personalization Foundation (PA-126.2).)
- operational: control groups; operational: margin-adjusted ROI
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incrementality-opacity risk**: Revenue counted without a holdout overstates lift; mitigated by control groups
- **Margin-blind risk**: Top-line promo lifts sales but erodes margin; mitigated by margin-adjusted ROI
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (links to VS-28.1); marketing (links to VS-14); coupons/promo (links to VS-58); merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101); trade (links to VS-11/VS-107); finance (links to VS-17.4); revenue assurance (links to VS-118); trade promo (links to VS-128)
Time Estimate: - ~1 week per major campaign close + quarterly rollup

steps.activity: CDP/Insights measure campaign/offer incrementality: treatment-vs-control lift, incremental revenue/margin, halo (links to VS-01 category), cannibalization, and cost (incl. discount/MDR links to VS-80) per campaign/offer
CDP/Merchandising/Finance measure margin impact (markdown links to VS-101, promo-leakage links to VS-118) and trade/promo ROI (links to VS-128), and flag unprofitable offers
CDP/Marketing publish results, retire under-performing offers, scale winners (links to VS-14/VS-58/VS-101), and report CDP-attributed value to the steering committee (links to W3881/W3904)
